description: Stores meter readings for shift operations, validates required pump/nozzle readings, and supports amendments.

fields.label: Series
fields.description: Naming series used to generate the Meter Reading document ID.

fields.label: Shift
fields.description: Shift record associated with this meter reading.

fields.label: Pump
fields.description: Pump for which the meter reading is recorded.

fields.label: Nozzle #
fields.description: Nozzle number for the pump reading entry.

fields.label: Reading Position
fields.options:
Shift Open
Shift Close
Carry Forward
fields.description: Position of the meter reading within the shift workflow.

fields.label: Meter Type
fields.options:
Electronic Volume
Electronic Cash
Manual Mechanical
fields.description: Type of meter used to capture this reading.

fields.label: Totalizer Value
fields.description: Meter totalizer reading recorded at the time of capture.

fields.label: Reading Date/Time
fields.description: Timestamp when the meter reading was recorded.

fields.label: Read By
fields.description: User who recorded the meter reading.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: Company to which this meter reading belongs.

fields.label: RTT Volume (L)
fields.description: Return-to-tank test volume dispensed at nozzle prime (Shift Open, Electronic Volume only)

fields.label: Amendment Of
fields.description: Reference to the original Meter Reading document when this is an amendment.

name: Meter Reading
